A team that wants every task handled forever is buying execution, and the agencies built for one aren’t built for the other. Once the shortlist is built, two questions on the first call separate the partners from the vendors. Ask for a named client where AI visibility produced pipeline, and watch whether the answer is a revenue figure or a citation screenshot. G2’s 2026 Answer Economy report found that 51% of B2B software buyers now begin their research in an AI chatbot more often than in Google, up from 29% just 11 months earlier, and 71% rely on AI chatbots for software research. Being named in that answer decides whether you make the shortlist or never appear on it. The demand is real and the readiness gap is wide, which is most of why this category of agency exists. When I screen agencies, the tell is whether the case studies lead with a revenue or pipeline number or with a traffic chart, because the ones reporting traffic almost never have the pipeline figure to fall back on. The agencies on this list that lead with pipeline are doing different work than the shops that report traffic value and link counts. Let’s Grow Your AI SEO Visibility Every agency on this list is genuinely good at something, and the right pick depends on what you’re actually buying. The thread connecting the best of them is that they optimize for being recommended, run AI search as part of one organic system rather than a bolt-on, and report in pipeline. If it’s a fit, we’ll explore how we can help. → Schedule a free strategy call today . Frequently Asked Questions About AI SEO Agencies What is an AI SEO agency? An AI SEO agency makes your brand visible and recommended across AI search surfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google’s AI Overviews, alongside traditional Google rankings. The work goes by several names, including answer engine optimization (AEO), generative engine optimization (GEO), and LLM optimization, but the goal is the same. It gets your company named and cited when a buyer asks an AI which vendor to choose. The best agencies treat this as an extension of SEO, not a replacement for it. How is AI SEO different from traditional SEO? AI SEO targets visibility inside AI-generated answers, while traditional SEO targets rankings on Google’s results page. The two share a foundation but diverge sharply at the surface. Traditional SEO earns the click while AI SEO earns the recommendation. A complete program runs both as one system because the underlying signals of authority, entity clarity, and useful content overlap even when the rankings don’t. What’s the difference between being cited and being recommended in AI search? Being cited means an AI model links to your content as a source. Being recommended means the model names your brand as an answer when a buyer asks what to buy. They’re separate (but related) outcomes connected by different work. Citations come from structural optimization like schema, FAQs, and content chunking. Recommendations come from closing content gaps, reducing entity ambiguity, and keeping your positioning consistent across the web so AI confidently names you. A strong AI SEO agency leads with recommendations and treats citations as the supporting structural play. How much does an AI SEO agency cost? AI SEO agency pricing generally runs from around $2,500/month at the entry level to $12,000/month or more for premium enterprise or full-service retainers, depending on scope. When you compare quotes, anchor on the pipeline outcome the work is meant to produce, not the retainer size alone. How do I know if an AI SEO agency is just repackaging old content services? Ask what outcome the agency optimizes for. If the answer is content volume, production speed, or “AI-powered content at scale,” you’re likely looking at a traditional content service with a new label. A genuine AI SEO agency optimizes for getting your brand recommended and cited in AI answers, and it can point to outcomes tied to pipeline or revenue, not just traffic charts and link counts The recurring warning across SaaS communities a lot of “AI SEO” is old SEO with an “AI” sticker. The one-question screen filters most of it out. Should the same agency handle both my SEO and AEO? Yes, in most cases one agency should run SEO and AEO as a single system. The two channels share a foundation but only partially overlap, so splitting them across a legacy SEO shop and a GEO pure-play leaves the connective tissue unowned and costs pipeline. The work that wins AI answers and the work that wins search rankings have to be coordinated by one team to avoid gaps. Google’s own guidance reinforces this: good SEO and good GEO are built on the same foundation, layered for different surfaces. How long does it take to see results from AI SEO? Most AI SEO programs show early movement in AI visibility within a few months, with meaningful pipeline impact compounding over 2 to 3 months as content, entity signals, and authority build. One of Optimist’s B2B technology clients grew 49x LLM referral revenue over 14 months, and a fintech client reached 8x LLM conversions in 8 months Timelines depend on your starting authority, how clean your entity signals already are, and how competitive your category is in AI answers. AI engines also favor fresh, frequently updated content, so the work is ongoing rather than a one-time fix. Tyler Hakes Tyler is the strategy director and principal at Optimist. They are the three problems we found when we compared what the agencies on this list actually sell. Lane one solves one problem: an AI engine cannot read your site. If the answer is a keyword list, the agency is in the wrong lane for you. How much of your AI visibility is branded. Branded means the question already contains your name. They need to know whether their employer’s leasing scheme, or a city grant, will pay for it. The keyword says e-bike. The need says funding. Most agencies cannot see this because they are stuck in keywords. They do not know how to recover these questions and group them into conversations. It matters because each question carries a different need, and the need changes as the customer moves from the trigger to the decision. Profile facts come from each agency’s own website and public profiles, checked on 1 October 2026. Results quoted are the agencies’ own reported numbers. How does Onely work? Before any content, any prompt list and any dashboard, we answer three questions with the client. I have used the same three for years, across very different products. What is the unique selling point? Why would someone buy this one rather than the other one? Not the spec sheet. The reason. Who specifically needs it? Which buyer we sell to, and which buyer we will never sell to. How do they go about solving it? This is the customer journey, and we walk it in order: What triggers the search. What they ask next, and in what order. Which engine answers each question today, and which brand it names. Where no brand answers yet. That is the gap. What the brand says there, published where the question is asked and tracked against the decision it belongs to. Worked example: a premium e-bike The example below comes from a client engagement, moved to a different product category so the client stays anonymous. Take a premium e-bike brand that sells in several European markets. Here is the third question, walked in order. The trigger. Nobody wakes up wanting an e-bike. They wake up because their employer offers a bike leasing scheme, or because their city pays part of the price. So the first question is not “which motor has the most torque.” It is “does this bike qualify for my scheme, and can you help me get it?” A keyword tool never sees that question. What AI answers today. In the engagement this comes from, I did what the customer does and searched for the product in the customer’s language. Google did not answer about the product. It answered about the money, and it named no brand. The brand showed up only as a product name inside resellers’ pages. The gap. On that engagement we checked every question where the brand appeared as a source in an AI answer. 94 percent of those questions contained the brand’s name. Where the funding questions get asked, no brand showed up at all. What it means. The brand enters the conversation at the comparison stage, after the customer has already learned from someone else. It arrives late. The action. Answer the funding question first, in the customer’s words, where it is asked, and track that answer against the decision it belongs to. The implication. When the trigger question has no brand in it, the first brand to answer has no competition. One article up the funnel can shorten the whole journey. What we believe The keyword is not the need. The need creates the questions, and those questions form the customer journey. The journey is where AI search is decided. A brand that appears only once its name is in the question has entered late. The work is to enter earlier, at the questions no brand answers yet. Judge the work by the decision, not the citation. A citation matters when it changes what the customer does next and what it sold. Never by clicks. Fail quickly. Each piece has to show up in at least one engine within days of publishing, or we rewrite it. If it does not get indexed and does not show up in ChatGPT, we remove it. You want a PDF audit to hand to a dev team. That is lane one, so hire lane one. The problem is the product. On one engagement our first honest reaction was that content is not the solution, and we said so on the call. We will tell you that too. What does an AI SEO agency cost, and how long does it take? The price follows the scope. No engine gave us a price, and most agencies do not publish one, because scope differs: how many markets, how many languages, and how much of the customer journey your content does not cover yet. One market with one trigger question is a different job from five countries with five journeys to map. So compare proposals on what is included, not on the monthly number, and ask what stays with you when the engagement ends. We quote by scope too. On time, ask what happens in the first weeks, because that is where you see whether it works. A good agency can tell you how it will know. At Onely we check each piece within days of publishing: is it showing in at least one engine, yes or no? If yes, we build on it. If not, we rewrite it or remove it. The aim is a first signal within days, and we begin measuring the effect on sales from the first weeks. Frequently asked questions What is an AI SEO agency? An agency that positions your brand to be recommended when people ask ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini or Claude. Some call the same work GEO or answer engine optimization. Is an AI SEO agency the same as an AI SEO tool? No. A tool shows you where you are mentioned. An agency does the work that changes it. Some teams need only the tool and their own people. Ask which of the two you are being sold. Is SEO still worth it in 2026? Yes. AI engines still read the web that Google ranks. If an engine cannot read your site, your site cannot be a direct source in its answer. That is lane one. It is necessary, and it is 10 to 20 percent of the work. Can an agency control what ChatGPT recommends? No agency controls an answer. What an agency can do is find the questions your customers ask, see which sources each engine leans on for each one, and publish the answer the customer needs where no brand answers yet. That raises the chance of being recommended, and the source behind each answer tells you whether it worked. How much does an AI SEO agency cost? Compare what is included, not the monthly number. How long until we see results? The first signal comes within days of publishing: a piece either shows up in an engine or it does not. The effect on sales is measured from the first weeks on. Do I need an agency if I have an in-house SEO team? Maybe not. If your team knows the questions customers ask before they know your category, and can publish and track the answers, you may not need one. One of our clients asked us exactly that before we started. If your team works from a keyword list, that is the gap a lane three agency fills. The next step Send us one product and one market.
